hero.name: Hudayfa
hero.title: Freelance web developer
hero.desc: I build business websites and develop Shopify stores: setup, migration from WooCommerce, theme rebuilds, one-off fixes. I work alone, directly with the client.
hero.imageAlt: Hudayfa Koujdal, freelance web developer, working at his computer

steps.label: What I do
steps.text: Business websites for small companies and independent makers, and Shopify stores: setup, migration from WooCommerce, theme rebuilds and one-off fixes.

steps.label: My background
steps.text: I learned on the job before I learned in class: WordPress at Synergie Media, Shopify and Liquid at Zakaria Outahar, then Vue.js and Strapi at monFeed. Professional Bachelor's degree in 'IT Professions – Web Applications' from the University of Limoges in 2025. Freelance since November 2025.

steps.label: How I work
steps.text: We discuss what you need, then I send a written scope with a price and a date. The work happens on a staging site, and it goes live once you have approved it.

items.title: Mudaparis — WooCommerce to Shopify migration
items.desc: Full store migration: products, collections and customer reviews transferred, then Horizon theme customisation. A brand of traditional Moroccan menswear. November 2025.

items.title: Amadal — rebuild and headless back office
items.desc: Site rebuilt with WordPress used headless as the back office, back-end work, SEO and performance. The homepage renders in under a second, with 286 KB transferred and a CLS of 0. Irrigation systems company. April 2026.

items.title: Sàntibé — cart rebuild
items.desc: Rebuild of the Horizon theme cart drawer: quantity updates, checkout path, visual consistency with the rest of the store. A jewellery brand. April 2026.

items.title: Soliferme — homepage rebuild
items.desc: New section structure, responsive build and Horizon theme customisation. December 2025.

items.title: Soraali and LXIR — Shopify maintenance
items.desc: Custom sections, snippets and buttons, theme debugging and one-off fixes on Shopify Horizon, for a fashion brand and a hydration tablet brand. 2026.

items.title: monFeed
items.desc: A platform to create, schedule and publish social media content: dashboard, editor, calendar and AI-assisted analytics. Final-year internship.

items.title: Flag
items.desc: A guess-the-flag game in JavaScript around a REST API. Group project, second year of my degree.

items.title: Gourmet Atlas
items.desc: A world cuisine explorer in Vue.js, on the World Food Guide API. Group project, second year of my degree.
